objective: Phase E: Advanced Evidence Verification & Cross-Document Conflict Detection for KnoTrail. Dual-status taxonomy (Evidence Validity vs Claim Verification), cross-source contradiction detection with two-sided conflict records, temporal supersession tagging, human conflict resolution, and Phase A handover gate enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Dual status taxonomy: Evidence Validity (MATCHED, MISSING, MISMATCHED, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE) and Claim Verification (SUPPORTED, UNCERTAIN, CONFLICTING, POSSIBLY_OUTDATED)
Distinguish quote existence from claim correctness ('No source, no claim')
Coordinate validation: Verifies line numbers and page numbers exist within the actual source document boundaries
Source ownership validation: Validates citations belong to sources present in the current workspace
Cross-document contradiction detection: Identifies opposing claims across sources (e.g. task completed vs pending, DB PostgreSQL vs MySQL, owner Alice vs Bob)
Structured ConflictRecord: Two-sided provenance with Finding A/B, Source A/B, exact quotes, page/line coordinates, category, severity, and resolution details
Temporal analysis: Detects newer documents superseding older ones and tags superseded findings as POSSIBLY_OUTDATED
Interactive Human Conflict Resolution: Reviewers can select the prevailing claim or enter consensus notes; resolves conflict and unblocks findings
Phase A Handover Gate Enforcement: Unresolved conflicts strictly block handover certification
Evidence Explorer & Review Center UI: Renders dual statuses, conflict badges, and two-sided comparison cards
Zero Fabrication Invariant: Verification and conflict detection run genuinely against uploaded source text; no preloaded/fabricated conflicts
18 automated test scenarios in src/__tests__/evidenceVerification.test.mjs pass cleanly
Full test suite passes (npm test) and production build succeeds (npm run build) with zero errors
non_goals: Do not break Phase A handover approval gates, Phase B persistence, Phase C ingestion, or Phase D Gemini extraction
Do not add login, signup, or authentication walls
Do not alter Google Stitch design tokens or warm sage aesthetic

verification.result: 65 of 65 automated tests passed across all suites (Phase A: 8 tests, Phase B: 9 tests, Phase C: 13 tests, Phase D: 15 tests, Phase E: 19 tests). Production build compiles cleanly with zero errors across all 15 API routes and 6 static pages. Verification engine thoroughly tests quotation matching, out-of-bounds coordinates, cross-source contradictions, temporal supersession, human resolution, and gate blocking.
